name: LLM Draft Infill
author: Mail Triage
description: Flow draft step (mode "plugin") with a template: only {llm-infill}...{/llm-infill} blocks are written by the LLM; everything around them stays exactly as typed. A template without blocks is filled literally, with no model call.

style.description: Style hint applied to every LLM-filled block (e.g. brief and friendly)

max_block_tokens.description: Token budget per filled block (16-1024, default 250)
